title: Related documents – document chain
html:
In the header of every document (quotation, order, purchase order) a document chain bar appears, showing which other document the given document is linked to. The elements of the bar are clickable — a single click takes you to the related document.

9.4.1How the document chain appears

QU-2026-0001 › CO-2026-0005 › PO-2026-0012

Situation What the chain shows How to navigate
On the quotation page Quotation number (active) › number of the related order Click the order element → the order page opens
On the order page Source quotation › order (active) › purchase order Click the name of the quotation or the purchase element
On the purchase order Source quotation › customer order › purchase order (active) Click the customer order element
